meta.title: Fix ReleaseRef build step
meta.body_summary: Adjust CI workflow test-build.yml to build only the ReleaseRef reference configuration instead of the entire solution, reducing build time.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit CI workflow fix to scope ReleaseRef build to reference configuration only; merged quickly with passing tests and no human review.
